_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bumbleride Speed Jogging Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Bumbleride Speed — Indie/Speed Car Seat Adapter – Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (MNC-28)

brake.type: foot-operated one-step parking brake linking both rear wheels (sandal-friendly). No hand brake.
brake.power: One-step foot brake links both rear wheels (no hand brake); fold has auto-lock; certified to AS/NZS 2088 (stricter parking-brake + tether standard). No published brake-force figure.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth with bassinet or infant car seat; 6 mo+ in the seat for jogging

safety.standards: ASTM F833 (US 16 CFR 1227); EN 1888 (EU); AS/NZS 2088 (AU/NZ); SOR/85-379 (Canada)
safety.certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 non-toxic fabrics; 5-point breakaway harness with shoulder pads. Not JPMA-listed.
safety.notes: Cargo basket 17 x 15 x 11 in, 15 lb. Cork handle. Adjustable footrest. Handle range 26–47.5 in.

recall.note: No US CPSC recall. Bumbleride issued a Canada-only voluntary safety notice for Speed units (SP-300 series) made Apr 2016–Dec 2017 over a potentially sharp back-hinge-plate edge, offering a free retrofit kit; company reported zero incidents.

specs.foldType: one-step ergonomic trigger-release compact fold with auto-lock, self-standing
specs.tires: air-filled; 12 in front / 16 in rear; Speed3 Steering front wheel (run/jog/walk: locked, partial-swivel, full-swivel)

notes: Bumbleride's dedicated performance jogger, 25.5 lb, 65 lb capacity. Clek Liing latches via the shared Indie/Speed adapter MNC-28 (adapter-mnc-28), which explicitly lists the Clek Liing. A sport jogger, not the compact-city answer, but on Clek's list and fully sourced.
